en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small town in a hilly rural landscape. The foreground is framed by dark conifer trees, with scattered farm buildings and houses leading into a compact village. A prominent church with a baroque-style tower stands among other multi-storey houses. In the background are open fields and meadows rising toward a forested ridge, with a light-colored road or path winding up the slope. The image has a white border and a caption printed at the lower left.
